name: IKEA PARASOLL (EU)

radios.note: IKEA's launch release describes the three sensors as built on Zigbee.

matter.note: IKEA says Zigbee devices on DIRIGERA can be made available through its Matter bridge. No page seen says PARASOLL itself is exposed, and no CSA listing was found.

apple_home.note: IKEA says the sensor works with Apple HomeKit through DIRIGERA.

alexa.note: IKEA's example is asking Alexa whether the door is open.

smartthings.note: No IKEA or SmartThings page seen covers PARASOLL.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's docs seen name no PARASOLL support. It pairs with ZHA or Zigbee2MQTT per forum posts only, and via DIRIGERA's Matter bridge it reportedly does not show up.

hubRequired.note: Phone notifications and smart-home links need a DIRIGERA hub (sold separately). Without one it can only trigger a paired TRÅDFRI bulb directly.

localControl.note: No page seen says whether it works without internet through DIRIGERA.

power.note: IKEA recommends one LADDA rechargeable AAA (HR03, 1.2 V) cell.

summary: PARASOLL is a two-part door and window contact sensor from IKEA that talks Zigbee. IKEA's DIRIGERA hub brings it into the IKEA Home smart app and on to Apple Home, Google Home and Alexa. Without a hub it can only switch a paired TRÅDFRI bulb. It takes one AAA cell, and IKEA recommends its LADDA rechargeable.
caveats: Needs a DIRIGERA hub for notifications and for Apple Home, Google Home and Alexa.
IKEA's Austrian help page says PARASOLL has left the range, with MYGGBETT as its replacement.
